description: This file contains implementation of bridge mode control functions, including enabling/disabling a bridge mode, managing network interfaces and bridging configurations, and handling related parameters. It also includes licensing and copyright information.

methods.name: amxd_status_t bridge_mode_none_enable(const amxc_var_t * const parameters)
methods.description: Enables the bridge mode by configuring network interface parameters, setting lower layer interfaces, and activating the IP interface.

methods.name: amxd_status_t bridge_mode_none_disable(const amxc_var_t * const parameters)
methods.description: Disables the bridge mode by removing interface references, disabling the IP interface, and clearing parameters.

methods.name: amxd_status_t bridge_mode_ctrl_action(const amxc_var_t * const parameters,bool enable)
methods.description: Controls the bridge mode, enabling or disabling it based on the parameter.

methods.name: int manage_bridge(const char * bridge_reference,const char * lower_layer,bool enable,mode_ctrl_t mode,uint32_t vlan_id,uint32_t vlan_prio)
methods.description: Manages the bridging configuration by adding or disabling ports with specific VLAN and mode settings.
